operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of the account's invoices and debit notes (and advance payments when that feature is enabled), most recent first.

The list supports rich filtering and sorting through the query parameters below.

By default each item contains the invoice header and its client only. Pass `recursive=1` to also receive the nested line items, payments, taxes, documents and custom fields.

Results are paginated (20 per page by default).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to 20. No maximum is enforced — very large values return very large responses.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description:
Association depth. Defaults to 0.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| -1 | Invoice header only |
| 0 | Header + client (default) |
| 1 | Also include line items, payments, taxes, documents and custom fields |

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Free-text search across client name, client number, email, invoice number and order number.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Filter by client id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Filter by document type. This endpoint returns Invoices and Debit Notes (and Advance Payments when that feature is enabled); this value narrows within that set.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Invoice |
| 16 | Debit Note |
| 19 | Advance Payment |

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client type (individual or business).

parameters.name: payment_status
parameters.description:
Filter by payment status. In addition to the standard status ids, these special values are supported:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| -1 | Draft |
| -2 | Due |
| -3 | Overdue |
| 3 | Subscriptions |
| 4 | Overpaid / credit |

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Set to 1 to return only draft invoices.

parameters.name: follow_up_status
parameters.description: Filter by follow-up status id.

parameters.name: currency_code
parameters.description: Filter by currency code (for example, USD).

parameters.name: no
parameters.description: Filter by invoice or order number (partial match).

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Return invoices that contain a matching item.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tag id(s).

parameters.name: po_number
parameters.description: Filter by purchase-order number. Available when PO numbers are enabled for the account.

parameters.name: external_source
parameters.description: Filter by creation source (for example, api or salla).

parameters.name: custom_field
parameters.description: Filter by a custom-field value. Combine with custom_field_label to target a specific field.

parameters.name: custom_field_label
parameters.description: Custom-field label to match together with custom_field.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Filter by parent/subscription invoice id.

parameters.name: work_order_id
parameters.description: Filter by linked work-order id. Available with the Work Orders plugin.

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.description: Filter by the source document type. Use together with source_id.

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.description: Filter by the source document id. Use together with source_type.

parameters.name: order_source_id
parameters.description: Filter by order source id.

parameters.name: shipping_option_id
parameters.description: Filter by shipping option id.

parameters.name: summary_total_from
parameters.description: Return invoices whose total is at least this amount.

parameters.name: summary_total_to
parameters.description: Return invoices whose total is at most this amount.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Invoice date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Invoice date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: due_date_from
parameters.description: Due-date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: due_date_to
parameters.description: Due-date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Created-date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: Created-date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: einvoice_status
parameters.description: Filter by electronic-invoice status. Available when e-invoicing is enabled.

parameters.name: requisition_delivery_status
parameters.description:
Requisition delivery status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | RECEIVED|
| 2 | REJECTED |
| 3 | PENDING|
| 4 | PARTIALLY RECEIVED|
| 5 | PARTIALLY REJECTED|

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.description: Filter by the staff member who created the invoice. Available with the Staff plugin and view-all permission.

parameters.name: pos_shift_id
parameters.description: Filter by POS shift id. Available with the POS plugin.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field name to sort by. Defaults to invoice date.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction: ASC or DESC. Defaults to DESC.
